summary: Exploratory investigation of how project status and open flows are wired across the gizmo app, the registry unity/git packages, and the duplicated protocol packages, in preparation for designing protocol v26 with per-extension routing.
decisions: Protocol v26 must carry an extensionId on project.status and project.open requests so the server can route to the correct extension's project service; v25 requests without extensionId are temporarily accepted and routed to the first-available service for compatibility.

ProjectCapability will request project.status per enabled extension that declares hasProjectStatus and store results per extension ID, keeping hasProjectStatus as the gate for whether to fetch/watch at all.

The registry repo's packages/protocol is a separate v25 copy containing Unity-shaped schemas (unityStatusSchema, unityOpenProjectResultSchema, parseProjectStatus, parseProjectOpenResult) that will need to be versioned alongside the gizmo repo's protocol as part of the v26 migration.
file.revert will also gain an optional extensionId in v26; the app's git UI continues to omit it, falling back to the v25 compatibility path since no dedicated git ProjectService exists.
